Item 4.    Information on the Company
A. History and Development of the Company
The Company was incorporated in 1998 and is a leading provider of industrial equipment and related services to customers in Europe and Asia.
B. Business Overview
The Company designs, manufactures and sells industrial machinery, and also provides maintenance and spare-part services. Its customers are primarily in the manufacturing, energy and transportation markets.
The Company sells directly and through distributors in more than 30 countries.
